message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: [developer.vimeo.com](http://developer.vimeo.com) → Create an app → Generate Access Token → choose Authenticated (you) → tick the public, private and video_files scopes → Generate, then copy the token immediately (it's shown once). Do it from the account owner / team admin login or it won't see everyone's videos, and send the token to us by secure means, never plaintext email, chat, or a ticket.

Please let me know if you have any questions about this process! You can also push the data to us if you have already started going down that route.
notes: The video_files scope is plan-gated, and a non-owner token cannot see other members' videos.
